The Gaza Civil Defense said its crews recovered the bodies of 129 Palestinians from under the rubble of 39 buildings destroyed by Israeli occupation aircrafts in the Nuseirat camp, Zawaida and Deir al-Balah city in central Gaza. The recovery is part of the second phase of the project to retrieve bodies from destroyed buildings. The first phase, launched in November 2025, recovered about 333 bodies and remains from 54 homes and buildings. Gaza's Health Ministry says more than 8,000 people remain missing under the rubble across the Strip. Entire families are missing under the rubble of their homes, massacred by Israel's mass bombardment of whole residential areas during the genocide.
